family_title_en: Spell the soft g or soft c word

stages.ix_title: Spell the soft g or soft c word

prompt.en: Which soft c or soft g spelling is right?
prompt.ko: 약한 c나 약한 g의 올바른 철자는 무엇인가요?

what_to_do.en: Tap the word spelled the right way.

stages.choice_rule: Each item has four unique whole-word spellings of one soft-c or soft-g word that fits the stem. Exactly one choice is the real spelling, and answer_index points to it. Take that word from the roots list or allowed_extra_words. The stem may use only the roots list, allowed extra words, and <NAME>, and it must not contain any choice.

gold_items.stem: Water that turned hard and cold.
It is how old someone is.
A place bigger than a town.
It is a fruit and a color.
Run and play in this school room.
One small bit cut from a cake.
<NAME> can see the road over the water.

roots: Offer four spellings of the same soft-c or soft-g word, and exactly one spelling is real.
Distractors are misspellings of that same word, never a different real word that also fits the clue.
For tier 1, one distractor may swap c with s or g with j, and the other two must look clearly wrong.
For tier 2, keep each distractor one letter off, such as c for s, g for j, or one wrong vowel.
For tier 3, use near misses that drop the silent e, drop the d in dge, or swap only the soft letter.
Choices are whole words. Never write IPA, slash sounds, or a held letter sound.
Keep clues in school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather, with no brand names.
Do not put the correct spelling or any choice inside the stem.
When the stem uses <NAME>, set swap_slots NAME to names.txt and never write a real name.

tier_rules.1: Clues of four to six words and a common one-syllable word such as ice, age, or face. Two distractors look clearly wrong.
tier_rules.2: Clues of five to eight words and a Grade 2 word such as city, orange, or gym. Distractors are one letter off.
tier_rules.3: Clues of seven to ten words. Distractors are near misses that drop silent e, drop the d in dge, or swap only c/s or g/j.

soft_c.en: Use c before e, i, or y when it sounds like the s in sun, as in ice and city.
soft_c.ko: e, i, y 앞의 c는 sun의 s처럼 들려요. ice와 city가 그 예예요.

soft_g.en: Use g before e, i, or y when it sounds like the j in jam, as in age and gym.
soft_g.ko: e, i, y 앞의 g는 jam의 j처럼 들려요. age와 gym이 그 예예요.

silent_e.en: The e at the end keeps the c soft, like the s in sun. Slice needs that e.
silent_e.ko: 끝의 e가 c를 sun의 s처럼 약하게 지켜요. slice에는 그 e가 필요해요.

soft_g_dge.en: Bridge ends in dge. The g sounds like the j in jam, and the e keeps it soft.
soft_g_dge.ko: bridge는 dge로 끝나요. g는 jam의 j처럼 들리고 끝 e가 그 소리를 지켜요.
